messages:
sam: Heads-up  AuroraHealth RFI landed. They want: capability matrix, POC ops plan, deployment mapping (hosted/dedicated/private), security appendix, and a 3-month pricing estimate for 95M tokens/mo + 7k embeddings. 48h turnaround. Who can own?

ingrid: Ill draft the capability matrix. Procurement specifically asked for separate rows for quantization profiles, adaptive batching, KV caching, model fallback, SSO, and KMS.

paul: Ill do the POC ops plan + deployment note. Will include canary example and explicit BYOK language.

sam: Please also include a one-page perf note for 2k context + 512 token gen and an exported PDF. Finance needs to confirm discount for POC.

ingrid: Uploaded draft matrix to drive: https://drive.internal/sales/aurorahealth/cap-matrix-draft.xlsx

paul: Ops runbook snippet to include: 

```
route: aurora-poc
model: redwood-7b-quant
batching: adaptive
canary: {pct:5, window:24h}
rollback: latency>1.8s || errors>1%
```

paul: Also adding table: Hosted = no infra in customer account; Dedicated = possible via VPC peering + reserved nodes; Private = deployable to customer VPC or on-prem with BYOK/HSM.

ingrid: Clarifying model weights Q: we dont hand over Redwood-managed performance weights. Open-catalog models can be provided under their licenses; note added to RFI answers.

sam: For pricing rough ballpark: hosted 3-month ~ $26k-$32k depending on model family and caching; small dedicated reserved pool ~ $42k/mo commit or ~$24k/mo with burst credits. I'll ping Finance now.

rfi-bot: (uploaded) aurora_rfi_assets_v1.zip - cap_matrix_draft.xlsx, rfi_answers.md, poc_ops_snippet.md, pricing_estimates.csv

ingrid: Security appendix draft includes KMS BYOK paragraph and SOC/ISO references. For Private we noted optional HSM and extended audit log retention (30/90/365 days).

paul: Adding explicit sentence: "Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and optional HSM integration; audit logs can be streamed to customer storage for Dedicated/Private with required IAM policies."

sam: Target to send final bundle tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Finance reply pending.

ingrid: Exported capability matrix as PDF and added perf one-pager for the requested workload.

rfi-bot: (uploaded) aurora_rfi_final_v1.zip - capability_matrix.pdf, rfi_responses.md, poc_plan.pdf, pricing_estimates_final.csv, perf_summary.pdf

sam: Sent to AuroraHealth procurement 2024-11-02T16:45:12Z with note: "RFI bundle + POC plan attached. Happy to schedule a walkthrough."

paul: Aurora asked: "Can you confirm SLA for Dedicated during POC and whether audit logs can stream to our S3?"

ingrid: Reply drafted: Dedicated POC SLA is region-dependent; we can commit to 99.9% uptime for reserved pools during the POC. Audit logs: yes, can stream to customer S3 for Dedicated/Private with appropriate IAM/bucket policy.

sam: Marking thread pending Legal sign-off on the RFI wording and Finance confirmation of final pricing. Will follow up in AM. :thumbsup:
